data.one_liner: An internal plugin for flutter_quill to access platform-specific clipboard and gallery APIs
data.what_it_does: Provides platform-specific APIs to interact with the system clipboard for HTML, images, GIFs, and files. Also allows opening the system gallery app and saving images to storage or gallery.
use_when: You are using flutter_quill and need platform-specific clipboard and media operations
You need to read or write HTML, images, and files to the system clipboard across multiple platforms
avoid_when: You are not using flutter_quill and need standard clipboard or file picking capabilities
You need general-purpose device information rather than quill-specific platform integrations
strengths: Cross-platform support for advanced clipboard types like HTML, images, and GIFs
Direct integration with flutter_quill package requirements
weaknesses: Intended as an internal package for flutter_quill rather than standalone general use
Requires platform-specific configuration such as FileProvider on Android and Photo Library permissions on iOS and macOS
data.setup_notes: Requires Android FileProvider configuration for clipboard image sharing, and Photo Library usage descriptions in Info.plist for iOS/macOS image saving.
